evals.prompt: create a confluence page about our Q3 roadmap
evals.expected_output: Claude gathers page details for the general_page pattern, writes a local draft to ~/_drafts/confluence/, asks for review, iterates on feedback, then publishes to Confluence only after the user explicitly approves the draft.
assertions: Claude reads the general_page pattern file from the patterns/ directory
Claude writes a draft to ~/_drafts/confluence/ before creating anything in Confluence
Draft filename uses lowercase with underscores (no spaces, no hyphens)
Claude asks the user to review the draft and requests approval before publishing
Claude does not call createConfluencePage until the user explicitly approves the draft

evals.expected_output: Claude verifies the Atlassian MCP is available, then presents the pattern selection prompt. If the MCP is unavailable, Claude stops and tells the user to enable it.
assertions: Claude calls getAccessibleAtlassianResources before proceeding to Phase 1
Claude stops and tells the user to run 'make enable_mcp server=Atlassian' if the MCP is unavailable
Claude does not proceed to pattern selection without a successful MCP connection
